productFrame.selectedProduct: ABIogenesis 5.0; GOAL-035 / T-287; fixed fifteen families F01-F07,F09-F11,F13-F17.
productFrame.activeSlice: RC6-based 5.0 qualification resumption; bounded Q23 identity HOW re-entry for F11/F15, retaining F04/F10 integrity.
productFrame.outcome: An independence-dependent qualification judgment uses truthful configured assessor identity, authenticated construction identity and the governing claim policy; unknown or conflicting correspondence stops before provider execution.
productFrame.authoritySplit: Product/requirements own acceptance; published qualification role and Validator own independence meaning; ABG owns invocation/admission and replay-derived truth; transport supplies configured execution facts; drivers select data and actors without granting policy.
productFrame.classification: Policy/profile declarations are immutable definitions; configured transport plan is deterministic construction; one existing transport-binding event is admitted invocation evidence; identity/eligibility projections are read models.
productFrame.prohibitions: No second dispatch path, identity service/registry/ledger, caller-independent flag, copied runtime authority, provider-attestation claim, or F_H response/resume expansion. F08/F12 and native human-response resumption retain their 5.1 boundary.

claim: Identify the smallest lawful existing-owner extension and whether current inputs already permit a positive pre-paid independence decision.
conclusion: The owner route is concrete. Positive dispatch eligibility remains indeterminate until the claim's source-bound identity/family policy and pre-existing attribution support are resolved. This is a proposal, not an adopted contract or implementation/qualification authority.

basis.verification: Previously reacquired exact installed release: installed=true, valid=true, failures=[]; current named control bytes rechecked.

design.canonicalBinding: Extend the existing actor_transport_binding_admitted body assembled in actor_process.ts:1050 and owned by event_store.ts's current payload contract. Use one owner-defined typed identity member, defined/checked beside WorkerTransportContract in transport_contracts.ts, imported rather than redeclared.
design.identityContents: Minimum semantic content: declared actor/profile identity and its source coordinate, with the exact effective configured model selection. Reuse the binding's existing agentKey, command/args, plan/contract/environment digests; do not duplicate them. The family relation belongs to published role policy, not a transport-inferred family string or independent boolean. Exact field/function names remain Worker HOW.
design.effectiveConfiguration: Derive/check identity from prepareWorkerTransport's final composed args and captured sanitized environment, not the driver's requested model label. Require the selected source-bound profile to match the actual supported agent/model configuration. Conflicting or ambiguous model options, an unresolved implicit default, or unsupported correspondence stays unknown/refused for required independence. runPreparedWorkerTransport must execute the same owned frozen plan. This establishes configured-selection correspondence under the trusted-desktop boundary, not cryptographic or server-side provider attestation.
design.historical: Retain old event contracts and absence as unknown; do not restamp historical events or infer identity from old actor role refs. Preserve unrelated calls with no independence obligation and existing not_required behavior; do not newly admit not_required qualification tasks.
design.projection: Extend c_call.ts's AdmittedActorTransportProjection/projectAdmittedActorTransport owner to expose a checked identity projection after its existing unique binding, digest and CCall/invocation/artifact joins. Expose/reuse that owning projection for qualification_proof.ts; do not implement a rival binding verifier.
design.referencesSuffice: QualificationJudgment.source and native producing Result evidence already carry actorInvocationRef plus transportBindingRef/transportBindingDigest. Resolve identity through these references for assessor, native authors and peers. No identity body is needed on every ActorProcessObservation, Result lineage, J, CCall or native provenance producer.

prePaidCheck.location: After actor_process.ts:1027-1047 prepares the final transport plan, before transportBindingBody admission/start transaction at1116 and runPreparedWorkerTransport at1380.
prePaidCheck.policyOwner: Use qualification_proof.ts's current consumer/role authentication and Validator's source-bound role policy. leaf_invocation_port.ts:1598-1623 already authenticates the selected call/input and retains PreparedQualificationAssessment.
prePaidCheck.smallestSeam: Extend the existing prepareActorProcessInvocation exact input/occurrence closure (leaf_invocation_port.ts:761-783; actor_process.ts:755-795) with an internal owner operation that receives the actual prepared plan's identity projection. It calls the existing native qualification owner/Validator relation against its retained input, resources, role and predecessor prefix. The operation is not serialized or caller-supplied evidence. This is a missing internal connection, not a new dispatcher.
prePaidCheck.coldRoute: The standalone invokeActorProcess path must authenticate the same selected qualification call and apply the same decision, or refuse when that owner context is unavailable. Existing rawResultOwner carries admitted port/resolution/input (actor_process.ts:667-668,1223-1227); its validation can support reacquisition, but presence alone is not authority. A missing closure must never bypass required eligibility.
prePaidCheck.decision: eligible only when actual configured identity matches the allowed profile and every required author/peer comparison has a source-bound positive independence relation and sufficient prior correspondence; ineligible for established prohibited relation; unknown for missing/conflicting inputs. Ineligible/unknown return the existing actor-process refusal before any actor/provider launch and cannot manufacture a J.
prePaidCheck.postExecution: Replay/native qualification reduction repeats the policy relation over the admitted binding and actual producing occurrences. Preflight is no substitute for completed artifact/transport evidence or semantic sufficiency.
prePaidCheck.precisePriorAttributionGap: projectExternalConstructionAttribution currently marks grounded only using judgment.raw.attributions (qualification.ts:861-865). That J does not exist before its own provider call. A strict pre-paid gate must consume already sufficient, source-grounded correspondence through the existing provenance/proof owner, or refuse unknown. It must not fabricate a raw attribution judgment, treat byte/chain validity as semantic sufficiency, or have the assessor justify its own eligibility after payment.

policy.alreadyFixed: Actual authorship and evidence conditions matter; a fresh context or renamed role does not erase authorship. STDO EVALUATION:257-260 defaults two activations of the same model family to non-independent absent a governing claim policy. Implementing that default needs no new waiver or Product feature.
policy.missingDeclaration: The published qualification role basis must name the selected actual actor/profile identities, their source-grounded model-family correspondence, and the independence relation admitted for the relevant author/assessor and, where selected, peer claims. Unequal model strings or provider-prefix heuristics supply neither family correspondence nor a positive independence declaration.
policy.owner: Existing Validator.Conformance/AF22 published QUALIFICATION_ROLE_POLICY at qualification_contracts.ts:110-120, source-bound to REQ-P-SELF-CONFORMANCE-007A and REQ-P-QUAL-064A through T287_D4_D5_NATIVE_QUALIFICATION_DESIGN.md:35,57-61. The Product/requirement authority owns semantic policy; Root selects actors under that policy. Worker owns representation, parser/check, closure plumbing and projection.
policy.noInventedPolicy: No same-family exception or concrete family taxonomy is selected by this proposal. Any requested exception requires the governing claim-policy owner, not an environment flag or ordinary Worker coding choice. Nor does merely declaring two different family labels prove independence.
policy.laneLimit: actor_process.ts:1023 currently selects the Claude transport. A different Claude model is not by itself proof of independence; this proposal does not add a second provider or claim an eligible live assessor exists.

sequence: Leaf owner authenticates CCall, exact task/resource and published role, retaining the native domain preparation.
Transport owner composes/freeze-checks actual plan and projects its configured identity.
Existing invocation closure asks qualification native owner/Validator for the claim's eligibility using prior authenticated authors/peers and policy.
Unknown/ineligible: existing prelaunch refusal, no actor/provider start and no J. Eligible: admit one identity-bearing transport binding and start through existing transport.
Existing Result/J retains transport coordinates; c_call projects identity from that binding; qualification_proof compares real authors/assessor/peers again at reduction/replay.

minimalOwningChanges.owner: Published qualification meaning and native join

acceptanceDiscriminator.status: Proposed finite discriminator only; none executed.
acceptanceDiscriminator.positive: One source-bound eligible author/assessor relation with exact profile/config match traverses the existing native path; cold read/replay recovers identity only from the single binding and existing Result/J references. Exercise native construction and a separately sufficient external record-set variant of that same relation.
nearestNegatives: Same family, unequal model strings and renamed role: non-independent under the default; zero provider starts.
Declared profile versus effective model mismatch, conflicting selector or unresolved default: refusal before binding/start.
External correspondence available only from the future J, or a conflicting/missing prior identity source: unknown and zero provider starts.
Required peer identity/family relation absent or prohibited: no dependent paid call; distinct invocation refs cannot rescue it.
Replace the referenced binding or alter its identity body: existing digest/causal join or policy projection rejects; no replay green.

Historical binding with no identity stays unknown for required independence; unrelated no-independence behavior remains unchanged. Changing ambient configuration after preparation cannot change the executed owned plan.
